raw.details:
Overview

Build ambitious, open-source projects with OmniRush in a six-day buildathon focused on engineering, experimentation, and innovation. Participants of all experience levels are welcome.

What You Get

  • 10 million GPT-6 Astra tokens, worth approximately $300 in free compute
  • Access to all GPT-6 models, including Astra
  • OmniRush sub-agents for parallel execution and complex workflows

How to Participate

  • Register for the competition on Unstop and install OmniRush.
  • Sign in using your registered email to activate your tokens and the buildathon countdown. Select a track and build your project.
  • Submit your project through the OmniRush dashboard to generate your Submission ID in the format OFB-XXXXXX.
  • Enter your Submission ID in your Unstop submission.

Competition Tracks

Agents & Automation

  • Autonomous agents and multi-agent workflows
  • Coding, research, and browser automation
  • Personal and business automation systems

Developer Tools & Open Source

  • IDE extensions and developer utilities
  • Testing, debugging, and code analysis
  • Open-source frameworks, APIs, and infrastructure

Research, Data & Scientific Computing

  • Research and literature analysis
  • Data pipelines and analytics
  • Scientific computing, simulations, and ML experiments

Systems, Infrastructure & Cybersecurity

  • Distributed systems and infrastructure
  • Networking, observability, and DevOps
  • Security, privacy, and performance tools

Human × AI

  • Education and accessibility
  • Productivity and knowledge management
  • AI-assisted professional and creative workflows

Open Frontier

  • Robotics and embedded systems
  • Hardware-software integration and novel interfaces
  • Experimental prototypes and unconventional ideas

Prize Pool: $300

  • 1st Place: $150
  • 2nd Place: $100
  • Best Use of OmniRush: $50

Rules & Guidelines

  • Participation is strictly individual.
  • OmniRush must be the only generative AI or agent tool used during development. Judges will review the associated OmniRush sessions.
  • All projects must be open source. Participants retain full ownership of their work.

Submission Requirements

  • Public GitHub repository
  • README with setup, execution, and testing instructions
  • Demo video
  • Live deployment, where technically feasible

Evaluation tip: Reproducible projects with a Dockerfile, pinned dependencies, and a single-command test setup are encouraged, particularly for the Best Use of OmniRush category.

Important Dates (IST)

  • Registration: 14 October 2026, 12:00 AM to 19 October 2026, 11:59 PM
  • Submission Deadline: 20 October 2026, 11:59 PM
  • Results: 25 October 2026

Build. Experiment. Push the frontier.
